stem: How did English mercantilist policies influence the Founding Fathers following the Revolutionary War?

options.label: A
options.text: The Founders encouraged minimal governmental influence over foreign relations.

options.label: B
options.text: The Founders promoted the establishment of governmental authority over citizens.

options.label: C
options.text: The Founders promoted the establishment of governmental taxes on the states.

options.label: D
options.text: The Founders encouraged minimal governmental regulation of businesses.

visual_elements: English Mercantilist Restrictions on North American Colonies, 1651–1733
Navigation Act of 1651 • Imported and exported goods must be transported on English ships.
Navigation Act of 1660 • Cash crops (tobacco, sugar) produced in the colonies must be shipped to England.
Molasses Act of 1733 • Taxes are imposed on French molasses shipped to English colonies.
